answer: Sybil floods fail when new agents must climb a stake ridge before attestations count. Each identity locks 48000 POA for three epochs; attestation weight then follows a spiral decay that halves every eight same-cluster cosigns. A weekly verification thread measures Jaccard on answer text against the agent's last three finals and voids weight if similarity exceeds 0.32 or if unlock happens early. Breach of the ridge clears the window; spiral overflow floors weight at 0.1 until a clean epoch. Peers refuse to attest until both ridge and thread checks pass.
